brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Quillnest, the writing app in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: encouraging and a little bold, for 13–17 year-olds, never childish or school-like. No owls, no pencils or quills drawn literally, no lightbulbs, no speech bubbles. App icon for iOS and Android plus a web version.

claim.notes: Üç yönün hepsi iki eskiz turunda da eleştirmenden none aldı, hiçbir konsept kapıya ulaşmadı; finalize, export ve galeri yapılmadı.

concepts.title: Open Cradle
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 crescent moon and star (religious/sleep symbol); s2 pen nib dipped in an inkwell / sailboat (near the banned quill); s3 winking smiley face (childish); s4 origami tulip or fox head, three loose parts; s5 smiley face / ear. Faces and crescent-plus-point dominate. Different move: fuse cradle and rising form into one closed silhouette (no floating gem above a curve), keep it angular, and check it never forms eyes+mouth or moon+star.

concepts.title: Rising Layers
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 app-grid/Windows tile icon; s2 target/egg-in-rings; s3 target or vinyl record with a tab; s4 crop/frame UI icon; s5 the stock 'layers' stack icon. Every sketch is generic UI geometry, and nesting copies is the cut/nested device. Different move: drop concentric/nested repeats entirely; draw growth as one asymmetric silhouette with a single unexpected gesture (e.g. a shape that breaks its own boundary), not a stack.

concepts.title: The Turn
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 lowercase n / 'rn' (a different letter); s2 awareness ribbon or dancing stick figure; s3 'c-' / toggle switch; s4 'D' or a pill toggle; s5 Tetris S/L pieces or stair/progress steps. s5 is the most energetic but its first reading is a Tetris piece and steps are a learning cliche. Different move: one continuous stroke whose turn makes an ownable, non-letter silhouette (avoid n/c/D/S); keep the two-colour hand-off, which is the only part worth keeping.
